import React from 'react' import './NewArrivals.css' import product1 from '../../Assets/product1.png' const products = [ { id: 1, image: product1, price: "Rs. 3500.00" }, { id: 2, image: product2, price: "Rs. 4100.00" }, { id: 3, image: product3, price: "Rs. 4000.00" }, { id: 4, image: product4, price: "Rs. 2500.00" }, { id: 5, image: "../../Assets/product5.png", price: "Rs. 3550.00" }, { id: 6, image: "../../Assets/product6.png", price: "Rs. 4000.00" }, { id: 7, image: "../../Assets/product7.png", price: "Rs. 3000.00" }, { id: 8, image: "../../Assets/product8.png", price: "Rs. 5000.00" }, ]; const NewArrivals = () => { return (

New Arrivals

{products.map((product) => (

Tailored Jacket

{product.price}

5.0 ★

))}
) } export default NewArrivals
